referee_caveats_inferred: No uncertainties are given on the temperature, column density, stream mass or infall rate, and the beta, kappa and gas-to-dust assumptions dominate them
Single constant beta = 1.5 and optically thin plus line-of-sight averaging may bias the T and N maps, notably near the disk
The CMU model neglects magnetic fields yet is used to argue the fields are dragged by infall; trajectory selection is a visual match to a 2D projection
Whether the Band 3 and Band 6 maps share the same resolved-out scales after uv matching is not demonstrated numerically; Band 3 field vectors use a lax PI > 1.5 sigma cut
The 90 deg rotation assumes B-aligned grains; Band 6 polarization may include self-scattering or radiative alignment effects not tested
Stream region boundary is hand-defined, so mass and infall rate depend on that choice

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Two ALMA projects (Band 3 and Band 6 polarization continuum); raw data likely tens of GB to about 100 GB; imaging products a few GB
